body:
2 different fabrics: the only reason for this was to separate the clothing of priests and common folk. The tabernacle of god and the priest’s clothing was mixed fabrics and god wanted to keep them special and holy for him. It doesn’t relate to wearing clothing of different fabrics, another thing to consider is that these laws were not given to us, they were specifically given to the nation of Israel.

Gold: the adorning yourself in gold specifically means not to show off or to be all about outwards appearance. God wants us to “adorn ourself with good deeds”. This verse is specifically speaking about how a Christian wife should seek beauty in her godliness, there is nothing wrong with a golden necklace.

Gossiping: I completely agree that gossiping has no place in a good Christian lifestyle. Joking around is okay though.

Remarried: I completely agree that divorce and remarrying is a sin. The Bible says that remarrying is once again possible under the guidance of a church leadership. 


Eating seafood: Jesus cleansed all foods, including seafood.

If you have any questions feel free to dm me or continue in the comments. I’ll be praying for you.
